verdict.rationale: Vercel Blob is Vercel's own first-party object storage, documented for storing images, videos, documents and other files the app uploads. Its docs include dedicated Server Uploads and Client Uploads pages, client tokens for browser uploads, multipart uploads, public and private access modes, and a region you choose for each store. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of upload persistence, and detailed evidence of the upload-flow docs beyond the overview and nav mentions.

support.subject: As a developer, I can persist user-generated uploads using built-in object storage

citations.quote: Vercel Blob is Vercel's object storage for files. Use it to store images, videos, documents, and other files your app uploads or serves.
Vercel Blob is a scalable, cost-effective object storage service with private and public access modes for files up to 5 TB.
Each store lives in one region that you choose, and Vercel's CDN caches your files close to your users.
